scope: Full two added test files reviewed against origin/main
assessment: Real ffmpeg-generated 24fps native take normalized to 30fps while preserving original bytes and binding executable digests
Existing destination preserved; short native take rejected without padding or final output
Normalization tool identities reject duplicate, missing and private path fields
Native tail tolerance distinct from strict final cadence/duration
Fractional 30000/1001 accepted within tolerance; incorrect size, codec, zero or doubled rate, NaN/short duration and multiple video streams rejected
limitations: Generated media exercises actual local encoder/probe, not real product capture or ASC ingestion
Window ownership and recording adapter process identity are separate test scopes
